content: Aditi asked Ramesh to clarify the amount she needs to pay to keep her health policy active. Ramesh confirmed a partial payment of 15,000 was applied, leaving a remaining balance of 15,000 out of a total due of 30,000, and warned that payment must be made within 48 hours to avoid expiration. He offered to assist with the payment process.

action_items: Customer to confirm whether to make the remaining payment of 15,000 now
Agent to process the payment if the customer agrees
